apps/api/src/mcp/mcp.tools.ts:incident-r.intended_behavior: A Credential holding incidents:read but not diagnoses:read must not receive Diagnosis content.
apps/api/src/mcp/mcp.tools.ts:incident-r.remediation: Project incident responses by the caller's MCP scopes, removing incident.diagnosis before deepRedact whenever diagnoses:read is absent; add a two-Credential regression test.

likelihood.reason: Requires a narrow-scope MCP Credential and an existing diagnosis.

impact.reason: Discloses private Diagnosis content within the Credential's own Project.

apps/api/src/work-items/work-item.public.intended_behavior: The configured maxOpenPrsPerHour limit must bound Project-wide publication admissions.
apps/api/src/work-items/work-item.public.remediation: Re-check and atomically reserve a Project-wide publication slot inside beginPublication using the same policy limit; add a deterministic two-attempt regression test.

likelihood.reason: Requires two eligible Work attempts and concurrent timing.

impact.reason: Exceeds the owner's configured publication cap for one Project.

apps/daemon/src/observations.ts:failed-o.intended_behavior: A terminally refused observation must be evicted and must not retain growing cumulative histories.
apps/daemon/src/observations.ts:failed-o.remediation: Validate the derived internal eventId against the DTO limit before watcher mutation, add terminal-delivery eviction, and bound the pending map.

likelihood.reason: Requires repeated unique long IDs from an authorized producer.

impact.reason: Demonstrated retained-history growth in a fixture; no measured process outage.

apps/daemon/src/observations.ts:service-.intended_behavior: An Event from one Project must not corrupt another Project's Haunting lifecycle cache.
apps/daemon/src/observations.ts:service-.remediation: Key the active-ID cache by [projectId, service] to match the watcher grouper, and add a two-Project close/reopen regression test.

likelihood.reason: Requires shared service names across granted Projects.

impact.reason: Causes a detection to be appended to a closed incident for another Project.

apps/daemon/src/reads.ts:collector-evide.intended_behavior: Collector inventory, logs, and metrics must be authorized for the requesting Project.
apps/daemon/src/reads.ts:collector-evide.remediation: Thread projectId through ReadRuntime and CollectorReads, enforce a Project-to-resource ownership predicate, and add a two-Project sentinel test.

likelihood.reason: Requires a shared daemon and a service name matching another Project's workload.

impact.reason: Returns or forwards another Project's private evidence.

daemon/fix-context/service-only-reposito.intended_behavior: A Fix must select only a repository authorized for the authenticated Project.
daemon/fix-context/service-only-reposito.remediation: Add a Project grant to repository policy and reject repository selection when caller.projectId is not authorized before any GitHub read.

likelihood.reason: Requires mutually untrusted Projects and a shared service-to-repository mapping.

impact.reason: Uses instance GitHub authority to read and draft in another Project's repository.

deploy/compose/api-service-overlay-retai.intended_behavior: A lower-trust example image must not inherit platform credentials or networking.
deploy/compose/api-service-overlay-retai.remediation: Use distinct Compose service keys and explicit !reset directives for environment and networks, or separate Compose projects, and validate the combined render in CI.

likelihood.reason: Requires the documented combined launch with the api profile and nonempty credentials.

impact.reason: Delivers platform credentials and core-network membership to the example workload.

fixer/recovery/parent-only-publication-b.intended_behavior: Draft recovery must verify the same immutable content identity that was originally verified.
fixer/recovery/parent-only-publication-b.remediation: Persist an expected tree/head digest in PublicationIntent and reject an existing draft whose head tree differs, including on replay reconciliation.

likelihood.reason: Requires an actor able to rewrite the generated branch.

impact.reason: Records an unverified head as the completed Fix.

fixer/sandbox/macos-detached-descendant-.intended_behavior: Every verification descendant must be terminated before workspace inspection and cleanup.
fixer/sandbox/macos-detached-descendant-.remediation: Own the full process tree with a supervisor that independently rejects on timeout and proves all descendants exited before success, inspection, and removal.

likelihood.reason: Requires macOS, a repository-executing verification command, and a detached child.

impact.reason: Demonstrated retained work and a workspace writer; no host credential escape or outage observed.

identity/account-password-change/stale-j.intended_behavior: Changing a password must invalidate other pre-change Account bearers.
identity/account-password-change/stale-j.remediation: Add a password epoch or session version to Account JWTs and verify it against stored Account state in AccountAuthGuard.

likelihood.reason: Requires prior possession of a valid bearer.

impact.reason: Retains owner capability inside the Account's own Organization.

identity/register-addMember/unverified-e.intended_behavior: Membership must be granted only to a principal that proves ownership of the invited email.
identity/register-addMember/unverified-e.remediation: Replace direct add-by-email with an invitation accepted from the mailbox-verified recipient before Membership activation.

likelihood.reason: Requires the owner to add an email already pre-registered by an attacker.

impact.reason: Grants attacker Project read and creation rights in the victim Organization.

identity/register-login/unthrottled-argo.intended_behavior: Anonymous password work must be admitted under an effective rate and concurrency budget.
identity/register-login/unthrottled-argo.remediation: Attach ThrottlerGuard to registration and login, or install an equivalent global admission guard, with a regression check on guard metadata.

likelihood.reason: Requires reachable identity routes without upstream admission.

impact.reason: Demonstrated admission gap and reached password work; no measured shared outage.

kiro-hooks.guard-shell.event-shape-fail-.intended_behavior: The shell hook must bind the real event shape and fail closed when the command cannot be identified.
kiro-hooks.guard-shell.event-shape-fail-.remediation: Validate the documented Kiro event schema, reject missing or unknown command fields with a blocking exit code, and normalize the command before denylist matching.

likelihood.reason: Requires a hook event shape outside the eight guessed fields or a semantically equivalent command.

impact.reason: Developer-host guard bypass; no product-server boundary demonstrated.

packages/actuator/createDockerRestarter/.intended_behavior: A Blessing must authorize only the signed service resource scope.
packages/actuator/createDockerRestarter/.remediation: Add a signed Project or Compose-project predicate to the signed action and container lookup, and verify returned container ownership before restart fan-out.

likelihood.reason: Requires act mode, shared-daemon co-tenancy, and duplicate service labels.

impact.reason: Restarts containers belonging to another Compose project.

packages/actuator/runtimeDecision/zeroed.intended_behavior: Runtime admission must evaluate policy with authoritative recorded usage.
packages/actuator/runtimeDecision/zeroed.remediation: Resolve diagnosis-loop and daily-spend usage from the authoritative Project context before calling runtimeDecision, on both local and API admission paths.

likelihood.reason: Requires an approved action delivered after limits are reached.

impact.reason: Executes a runtime action that current policy would deny.

packages/events/src/consumer.ts:projectl.intended_behavior: Event replay identity must be scoped by Project.
packages/events/src/consumer.ts:projectl.remediation: Namespace publisher msgID and consumer completed-ID keys by [projectId, id] while preserving same-Project replay deduplication.

likelihood.reason: Requires a predictable target Event ID and a shared consumer.

impact.reason: Suppresses another Project's observation without dispatch.

packages/integrations/src/delivery.ts:pe.intended_behavior: One permanently invalid workload record must not block the shared Collector queue.
packages/integrations/src/delivery.ts:pe.remediation: Distinguish permanent validation failures from transient errors, quarantine or drop them, and continue with later records.

likelihood.reason: Requires delegated control of a workload name or label.

impact.reason: Demonstrated head-of-line blocking in a fixture; no measured service-wide outage.

packages/redactor/src/detectors.ts:email.intended_behavior: A bounded telemetry string must not cause disproportionate synchronous work.
packages/redactor/src/detectors.ts:email.remediation: Anchor and bound the email detector's local part and impose a per-string scan limit before redaction.

likelihood.reason: Requires a long non-matching telemetry string within the accepted byte caps.

impact.reason: Demonstrated cost growth; no measured delay to unrelated work.

packages/watcher/src/rules.ts:unbounded-.intended_behavior: Temporal sample storage and work must be bounded by the rule threshold and window.
packages/watcher/src/rules.ts:unbounded-.remediation: Cap the error and restart arrays at their thresholds and expire samples against wall clock rather than only the producer timestamp.

likelihood.reason: Requires repeated unique Events with stale or equal timestamps.

impact.reason: Demonstrated growing element visits; no measured service impact.
